name: Army Fitness Test (AFT)

source.document: Army Fitness Test Score Tables (AFT scoring scales, 100 to 0 points)

variants.label: Combat MOS (sex-neutral: the male column, 350 points in total)

caveat: Each event is scored from 0 to 100 points and needs at least 60. The total needs 300 points (350 for a combat MOS). The alternate aerobic events (2.5-mile walk, bike, swim, row) are pass or fail with no points and are not included here.
